<!-- In order to run the node-create command a folder to hold the data must exist, it can be named "data" or whatever other name that serves the purpose, but must match the commands -->

<!-- On each step is important to overwrite each account number with the one generated by the node-account.bash command -->
<!-- Once executed it must be copied from data/keystore/UTC... {"address":"0x012345678..."}}-->
<!-- Then add it as the first account within the genesis.json to be able to run the node-genesis.bash -->
<!-- And finally also added to the node-launch.bash parameters, this will allow to launch the ETH node to be mining into the correct account -->
